Interface PowerReadingData

All Known Subinterfaces:
PowerData.Payload, PowerDataIBX
All Known Implementing Classes:
PowerDataIBXJson, PowerDataJson.PayloadJson
public interface PowerReadingData
The shared power-reading shape for a single hierarchy node, common to both the payLoad of a GET /power/v1/current response (PowerData.Payload) and an entry in the payLoad.data array of a POST /power/v1/current response (PowerDataIBX).
